g.card: Chinja maswitch enjanji uye utungamire ngoro yemugodhi imwe neimwe kunobudiwa kweruvara rwayo.
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: mapuzzle enjanji 90 mumapako ekristaro 6. Chinja maswitch uye utungamire ngoro imwe neimwe kunobudiwa kweruvara rwayo.
g.p1: Ngoro dzinobuda mumugero uye dzinomhanya dzega. Chinja maswitch kuti imwe neimwe isvike kunobudiwa kweruvara rwayo isingarovane.
g.p2: Mazinga 90 mumapako 6: malever, mabhiriji anotenderera, chando, mvura inokwira nelava. Wana nyeredzi 3 nemafambiro mashoma, uye mudiki anokubatsira kana wanamatira.
l.card: Tendeutsa magirazi, tungamira mwenje uye ubatidze zvakare dzimba 150 dzenhare.
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: tendeutsa magirazi uye utungamire chiedza kumakristaro mumazinga 150 nenyika 6 dzakapendwa.
l.p1: Nhare yadzima. Tendeutsa magirazi nedzimba kuti utungamire mwenje kumakristaro: kana ese achipenya, gonhi regoridhe rinovhurika.
l.p2: Mazinga 150 munyika 6: mavara ekusanganisa, magirazi ane mavara, maprism, zvifananidzo nemagiya. Mazano nenyeredzi 3 pazinga rimwe nerimwe kune vakangwara.
l.f2: Magirazi, maprism, magirazi ane mavara nemagiya
d.card: Mhanya, bhururuka uye ufemere moto muumambo hwemashiripiti 7 nevakuru vadzo 7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: mutambo wepuratifomu we2D wakapendwa nemaoko. Yambuka umambo 7, mazinga 63 nevakuru 7 kuti udzinge Mambo weMimvuri.
d.p1: Tamba sedhiragoni diki dzakasvibira rine ushingi. Mhanya, svetuka, bhururuka zvinyoro uye ufemere moto kuti udzinge Mambo weMimvuri.
d.p2: Umambo 7, mazinga 63 nevakuru 7, mumwe nemumwe ane hunyanzvi hwake. Unganidza makristaro uye uwane kusvika nyeredzi 3 pazinga.
d.f2: Vakuru 7 vekukunda, mumwe nemumwe nehunyanzvi hwake
t.card: Cheka, tendeutsa uye uise makore kuti uvhurire musoni mudiki nzira.
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: mapuzzle 240 munzvimbo 12 dzedenga. Cheka, tendeutsa uye uise makore kuti uvhure nzira.
t.p1: Zvitsuwa zvinoyangarara mudenga uye gonhi remashiripiti rakamirira. Cheka makore, atendeutse uye uaise kuti uvake nzira yemusoni mudiki.
t.p2: Mazinga 240 munzvimbo 12 dzakapendwa, pasina wachi. Wana nyeredzi 3, vhura mabhokisi uye unganidza makore.
w.card: Isa magiya, pfuudza simba uye umutse umambo hwakarara.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: mapuzzle emichina 150 munyika dzengano 6. Isa magiya uye upfuudze simba kuti michina itange zvakare.
w.p1: Chituko chakaomesa umambo. Isa magiya panzvimbo chaiyo kuti upfuudze simba reinjini yemashiripiti uye michina ishande zvakare.
w.p2: Mazinga 150 munyika 6: marune, malever, mwenje wekristaro newachi yejecha. Wana nyeredzi 3 uye utarise mamepu achidzosa mavara awo.
u.card: Isa mabhuroko emarune ari kudonha uye ubatanidze marune eruvara rumwe kuti anyangarike.
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: isa mabhuroko emarune ari kudonha, batanidza mavara uye usunganidze macombo mumazinga 180 nenzvimbo 6.
u.p1: Mabhuroko emarune anodonhera pabhodhi. Afambise uye uatendeutse kuti ubatanidze marune eruvara rumwe: anonyangarika uye zvese zvinodonha pasi.
u.p2: Mazinga 180 munzvimbo 6, kubva kuShongwe yeN’anga kusvika kuNhare yeDenga. Sunganidza macombo kuti uwane nyeredzi 3.
n.card: Tungamira dhiragoni, idya marune uye ukure usingarume muswe wako.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: mutambo wenyoka une dhiragoni. Idya marune, nzvenga zvipingamupinyi uye ukunde varindi 6 mumazinga 120.
n.p1: Dhiragoni harimbomira. Swipa kuti uritendeutse, idya marune kuti ukure uye unzvenge madziro nemuviri wako.
n.p2: Mazinga 120 munzvimbo 6, imwe neimwe inorindwa nemukuru. Marune emashiripiti anononotsa nguva, anokuita chipoko kana kukudzivirira.
